items.rationale: The bicycle and its frame are excluded means of transport under 4.3(b); 7.1.8(a) excludes the replacement cost in full.
Clause 4.3(b) expressly excludes bicycle braking assemblies, so the entire replacement line is excluded under 7.1.8(a).
Carriage associated with the uninsured bicycle is excluded in full under 4.3(b) and 7.1.8(a).
The workshop performed no covered building work, so its vehicle charge is excluded under 7.1.8(a) and (f).
The assembly work is entirely for the uninsured bicycle and is excluded under 7.1.8(a).
Under 7.1.8(a) and 7.1.10, all sundries allocated to the uninsured bicycle repair are excluded.
The one apprentice hour was spent on the uninsured bicycle and is excluded under 7.1.8(a) and 7.1.10.
All three skilled-worker hours relate to the uninsured bicycle and are excluded under 7.1.8(a) and 7.1.10.
Clause 7.1.7(g) covers one attendance by the locksmith to repair the forced door; allow €75 gross for the single visit, not a charge based on parking duration.
Clauses 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover fitting and testing a like-for-like replacement lock. Allow €65 gross for the fitting charge, excluding any work already billed in the hourly lines under 7.1.8(g).
Clause 7.1.7(f) covers sundries incorporated into the damaged door and lock repair; allow €25 gross for ordinary fixings and consumables.
Clause 7.1.7(e) covers necessary labour at every grade on the damaged door; allow one apprentice hour at €42 gross.
Clause 7.1.7(e) covers necessary skilled labour to restore the forced door and lock; allow one hour at €95 gross. No event deductible amount is stated.
